name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with engines. Growing up in a small town near Lisbon, he spent countless hours helping his uncle, a local mechanic, repair cars and motorcycles. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduation, he initially worked in the automotive industry, but his heart always yearned for the adrenaline and precision of racing. He volunteered at local karting events, eventually catching the eye of a team manager who offered him a position.

As Head of Operations, Ricardo prides himself on his meticulous planning and problem-solving skills. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. His deep understanding of both the technical and logistical aspects of racing allows him to anticipate challenges and implement effective solutions. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to the team's success. Ricardo is distinguished by his ability to balance the pursuit of innovation with the importance of reliability, ensuring that the team is always pushing the boundaries of performance without compromising its stability.

Ricardo's dedication extends beyond the track. He actively mentors young engineers and mechanics, sharing his knowledge and experience to help them develop their skills. He is a firm believer in investing in the next generation of motorsport professionals and is committed to creating opportunities for aspiring talent to thrive.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused expression, often seen wearing glasses.
